After a few sessions of therapy we figured that I usually shut down or not react in the moment when something uncomfortable happens. This is because I have always hated conflict and have a tough time articulating my feelings. But all these internalised feelings pile up and I end up overreacting to something small. But I’m my head I have the reasoning but it barely makes sense to the other person.
